sections.title: Materials
points: Silver: The best metallic conductor (too expensive for home use).

sections.title: The Fuse
points: Made of an alloy of Tin and Lead.
It melts (blows) to protect appliances from fire during an overload.

sections.text: Short Circuit: A shortcut path of low resistance. It causes sparks and fires. Earthing helps prevent shocks by sending stray current to the ground.

cards.fact: A liquid that conducts electricity (Salt water, Urine).
Too many appliances on one socket.
